Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.

Department Overview
Motorola Solutions is looking for a Product Manager to join our cloud-based video management platform team. Our VMS platform processes millions of video streams daily, delivering intelligent insights on top of Avigilon's industry-leading cameras and third-party hardware.
Job Description
This role is primarily remote with occasional travel to our UK offices.

You'll be part of an empowered product team operating with a start-up mindset inside a large enterprise. Reporting to the Director of Product Management for Cloud Video Security, you'll own the most compelling and fastest growing product area within our video platform, working directly with engineering, design, and customers to solve real security problems. This role is hands-on: you'll run discovery, define outcomes, ship product, and measure results.

What You'll Do
- Own a Product Area: Take full ownership of the VMS product within our video platform. Define outcomes, run discovery, and drive the roadmap for your area in close partnership with your engineering team.

- Run Continuous Discovery: Talk to customers regularly. Conduct interviews, observe workflows, analyze usage data, and synthesize what you learn into clear problem statements and opportunity assessments.

- Ship Product That Matters: Work with engineering and design to move from problem to solution to delivery. Write clear product specs, make scope trade-offs, and ensure what ships actually solves the problem you set out to solve.

- Measure Impact : Define success metrics for your area and instrument your product to track them. Use data to inform decisions, validate hypotheses, and demonstrate business impact.

- Contribute to AI-Native Strategy: Help define how AI and analytics capabilities get integrated into the video platform to move us from basic video management toward intelligent security workflows.

- Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with Sales, Support, Marketing, and other products teams within Motorola Solutions to ensure successful launches and tight feedback loops from the field back to the product team.

​
Understand the Market: Stay sharp on competitors, industry trends, and the evolving needs of security professionals. Use competitive intelligence to inform positioning and product decisions.

Basic Requirements
What You'll Bring
- Product management experience in SaaS, cloud platforms, or enterprise software

- Experience with video surveillance or video analytics strongly preferred

- Demonstrated ability to run customer discovery and translate findings into product decisions

- Comfortable working directly with engineering teams, including the ability to engage in technical discussions about architecture and trade-offs

- Experience defining and tracking product metrics, and using data to drive prioritization

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate product strategy and rationale to both technical and non-technical audiences

- A bias toward action and learning over perfection, with experience shipping product iteratively

What Sets You Apart
- AI Fascination and Vibe Coding Experience: Gone are the days when only the engineers could code. We expect you to be able to stand up AI generated prototypes rapidly and iterate on them.

- AI/ML Product Experience: You've integrated AI or analytics capabilities into a product, whether for intelligent video, predictive insights, automation, or similar. Bonus if you can point to measurable reduction in manual effort through AI.

- Security Industry Knowledge: You understand the physical security ecosystem, including installers, integrators, and end-user workflows across verticals like retail, education, or healthcare.

- Cloud + On-Prem Hybrid: Experience with products that bridge cloud and on-premise deployments, or with migration strategies from legacy to cloud architectures.

- Multi-Sided Ecosystem Thinking: You've worked with products that serve multiple stakeholder types (partners, installers, integrators, end-users) and understand the trade-offs involved.

- Technical Depth: A technical background (CS, engineering, or similar) that lets you go deep with engineering on system design, APIs, and platform architecture.

Why Motorola Solutions?
Join a team that's transforming physical security through innovative technology. You'll work on products that protect people and spaces, with real autonomy to drive outcomes and grow your career at a global technology leader committed to making communities safer.

In return for your expertise, we’ll support you in this new challenge with coaching & development every step of the way. Also, to reward your hard work you’ll get:

- 25 days holiday entitlement + bank holidays.

Detailed responsibilities include:
The Product Manager is the mini-CEO of their product/offer. They analyze customer environment, market and competitive conditions and lay out product vision that solves the market problem and delivers value to the customer. They will do this by defining the ‘why’, ‘what,’ ‘where’, and ‘when’ of the product that the development team will build. They are the owner of their product -- which means they lead cross-functional teams from a product's conception through to its launch. Their responsibilities will span many activities from strategic to tactical and provide cross-functional leadership — bridging gaps within the company between different functions, especially between development, supply chain, finance, sales and marketing, and service and support. Post-launch, product managers monitor their portfolio and identify and implement actions to boost the performance of the portfolio. This includes sunsetting products if required.

Product Strategy
The product manager is responsible for setting a product vision and strategy. Their job is to clearly identify the problem the product is solving and the value to the customer and to Motorola Solutions. They will need to be able to articulate this to the cross functional team including sales and senior management so they understand the intent behind the new product or product release. They own the strategy behind the product along with its roadmap and must work with development to define, prioritize and build what matters.

- Evaluate competitive intelligence

Product Releases

- Define market offer and structure

Responsible for making product decisions and often is the lead resource for the rest of the organization when deep product expertise is required. This includes supporting the organizations that help bring the product to market and work directly with customers including marketing, sales, training and support services.

About CRFS
CRFS, part of Motorola Solutions, is a world leader in radio frequency (RF) spectrum monitoring, intelligence, and geolocation technology. Our mission-critical solutions empower defence, national security, and regulatory agencies worldwide to detect, identify, and geolocate signals of interest in complex electromagnetic environments. Operating at the cutting edge of spectrum dominance, electronic warfare, and signal intelligence, our RFeye ecosystem combines ruggedized sensors, direction-finding arrays, and advanced software suites.

The Role
We are seeking an ambitious, technically grounded Junior Product Manager to join our Product Management Team.  Bridging the gap between engineering capabilities and real-world customer missions, this is not a "pure" product management role; it requires a technical understanding of electronic and RF/communication systems.
In this role, you will work closely with a Senior Product Manager to help drive the lifecycle of our electronic hardware, RF sensor platforms (RFeye Nodes), and embedded system architectures. You will be using our products and tools to run simulations, compile data, explore ideas, and present findings – as well as supporting product improvement activities and helping to solve customer needs.
This is an ideal opportunity for a Graduate Electronics/Systems Engineer or a Junior Systems/Product Specialist with 1–2+ years of industry experience looking to start or develop their career in technical product management within a dynamic, fast-paced technology business.

Key Responsibilities
- Simulations, Testing & Prototyping: Get hands-on with wireless and signal processing product developments. Run simulations, test new hardware, compile data, and explore product concepts to understand system capabilities and limitations.
- Product Evolution & Lifecycle Support: Assist in driving the technical roadmap for RFeye hardware, sensor platforms, and embedded architectures from concept to deployment and end-of-life. Contribute to activities to ensure that RFeye products meet customer requirements.
- Problem Solving:  In conjunction with senior product managers, provide support to the sales and business development teams, exploring system configurations and features to meet customer needs.
- Market & Customer Insight: Research competitor products, analyse emerging technologies across RF sensing and Electronic Warfare, and compile market/Voice of Customer (VoC) insights.
- Hands-on Engineering:   Be hands-on with wireless and signal processing product developments to understand their capabilities and limitations, with a view to ensuring they are the best they can be.

- Education:  Degree in Electronics Engineering, Systems Engineering, RF / Microwave Engineering, Telecommunications, Physics, or a closely related technical field.
- Experience Level: - A keen Graduate with good grades and a strong electronics/radio systems project background, OR
- 1–2+ years of technical experience in RF, telecommunications, defense, or aerospace.

- Technical Aptitude: Understanding of fundamental electronic system architectures, basic RF principles (e.g., frequency bands, signal propagation, dynamic range, noise floor, antennas), and embedded systems.
- Problem-Solving & Commercial Mindset: Analytical and structured approach to problem-solving, with an eye for trade-offs between cost, time-to-market, SWaP (Size, Weight, and Power), and performance.
- Communication and Approach:  Good communication skills, both written and verbal. A positive attitude and ability to get things done, whilst being a committed team player.  An ability to build strong relationships and collaborate with colleagues and clients on product requirements and specifications.

Artificial Intelligence is transforming the physical security landscape, and this role is at the center of that evolution. You will bring a proven track record of having shipped AI/ML products at scale, taking complex models out of research and deploying them into production environments serving high-volume, real-world workloads. Department Overview
Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.
Job Description
Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “ Keeping Our Heroes Connected ”?

THE OPPORTUNITY
Silvus is seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager (TPM) to drive technical requirements, backlog ownership, market adoption, and revenue growth of our Spectrum Dominance product portfolio. This position will report to the Director of Product Management on the Product team. The successful individual in this role will play a vital role in translating complex defense requirements and highly advanced R&D algorithms into software features, firmware builds, and intuitive operator experiences. This is an execution-focused role that acts as the key technical conduit between our advanced waveform R&D team and our engineering, operations, and go-to-market teams.

The Technical Product Manager will take technical ownership of Silvus' spectrum dominance suite. Their mission is to translate complex mathematical algorithms and signal processing research—specifically in Low Probability of Intercept / Low Probability of Detection (LPI/LPD) and anti-jamming into actionable requirements. By bridging the gap between theoretical R&D and reliable military systems engineering, the Technical Product Manager will ensure Silvus outpaces emerging electronic warfare (EW) threats and delivers robust software-defined spectrum dominance. The role requires up to 25% of travel to support field testing, customer integrations, or customer meetings.

This position is located at Silvus Technologies’ Engineering and R&D Office in Irvine, CA , near the vibrant Irvine Spectrum and is on a hybrid schedule, with one day reporting to our West Los Angeles HQ. On-site days are Mondays, Tuesdays, and Wednesdays at our Irvine office and Thursdays at our West Los Angeles HQ.

The following is a list of at least some of the current essential job functions of the position. Management may assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time at its discretion.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.
Job Description
Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “ Keeping Our Heroes Connected ”?

THE OPPORTUNITY
Silvus is seeking a highly motivated Technical Product Manager (TPM) to drive requirements, product backlog, market adoption, and revenue growth for the Electronic Warfare (EW) & Sensing Solutions product portfolio. This position will report to the Director of Product Management on the Product team.

The successful individual in this role will play a vital role in translating complex defense requirements into specific hardware configurations, software specifications, and intuitive operator experiences. This is a technical execution role requiring a deep understanding of tactical RF networks, signal analysis, sensing systems, and software-defined architectures.

This position bridges the gap between tactical EW mission requirements and engineering execution. While Silvus’ core hardware team drives the physical New Product Introduction (NPI) of Silvus’  flagship radio chassis, this role drives the hardware New Product Introduction (NPI) and complete physical lifecycle execution for our highly specialized FASST Sensing Technology and related products. Additionally, you will focus on the tactical application of our core technologies—optimizing our transceiver platforms for edge-node operations and enabling high-performance RF data exchange with downstream processing applications and external tactical ecosystems. You will hold complete technical requirements, hardware NPI, and user experience ownership for our sensor products. The role requires up to 25% of travel to support field testing, customer integrations, or customer meetings.

This position is located at Silvus Technologies’ Engineering and R&D Office in Irvine, CA , near the vibrant Irvine Spectrum and is on a hybrid schedule, with one day reporting to our West Los Angeles HQ. On-site days are Mondays, Tuesdays, and Wednesdays at our Irvine office and Thursdays at our West Los Angeles HQ.
